notes.content:
[h1]v 0.1.1 - QoL and Bug fixes [/h1]

[list]
[*]Ledge detection mechanic has been implemented for smoother, and more forgiving platforming.
[*]Enhanced drop shadow setting: check your options menu!
[*]Fixed traffic lights
[*]Tweaks, fixes, and gameplay adjustments in Midway Metropolis
[/list]

notes.title: Major Metropolis Update
notes.content:
Major Metropolis Update

The first major update for The Static unlocks a brand new world!

- A new world: The Midway Metropolis
- A new area in the Neighborhood 
- More cosmetics
- More settings
- Various bug fixes and improvements

tags.feature: - A new world: The Midway Metropolis
- A new area in the Neighborhood

notes.title: The Static Patch Notes -- Version 1.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented healing during cutscenes.
[*]Resolved collision issues where the player could get stuck.
[*]Tweaked neon flowers to reduce “stickiness.”
[*]Adjusted some Channels in The Strangle Tangle.
[*]Fixed falling leaf collisions.
[*]Resolved collision issues that made certain hearts from enemies unreachable.
[*]Updated some dialogue.
[*]Added missing collision elements.
[*]Removed misleading “new area” text upon completing The Strangle Tangle.
[*]Added a version number to the title screen.
[*]Implemented Game Over effects.
[*]Fixed transition issues.
[*]Resolved various audio problems.
[/list]
